title: GrapheneOS: Documenting Numerous Attacks Against CalyxOS,, Techlore, & More
summary: A long Techlore video documenting what it presents as hostile conduct by GrapheneOS leadership and community members, including lead developer Daniel Micay, toward CalyxOS and others.
why: HN commenters cite it, mostly critically toward GrapheneOS, as the source for the CalyxOS side of the dispute.

quote.text: There's a long video from Techlore which presents the CalyxOS side of the picture and places the blame with GrapheneOS leadership
